metadata.title: Dawn-inspired Delivery and Deployment Model
metadata.description: Proposed Productscape model inferred from public offerings; not Dawn internal architecture, roadmap, organization or measured performance. Client applications, engagement workspaces, contracted support and group enablement have distinct responsibility and data boundaries.

channels.description: Project-isolated research, architecture, scope, build, test and evidence tools. Client approvers own investment and acceptance; shared standards do not imply shared client records.
channels.operatingFlow: A qualified brief and signed scope start delivery; evidence review and accepted working increments control progression.
channels.mvpScope: One client, one bounded task, one reviewed release and a demonstrated build/restore path.
